description: Source code for managing scheduled posts in the Mattermost server, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and publishing scheduled post events.

methods.name: SaveScheduledPost
methods.description: Creates and saves a new scheduled post after validation and checks, then publishes an event.

methods.name: GetUserTeamScheduledPosts
methods.description: Retrieves scheduled posts for a user within a team, including preparing draft file info.

methods.name: UpdateScheduledPost
methods.description: Updates an existing scheduled post after validation, restoring non-updatable fields, and publishes an event.

methods.name: DeleteScheduledPost
methods.description: Deletes a scheduled post permanently and publishes a deletion event.

methods.name: PublishScheduledPostEvent
methods.description: Publishes a websocket event related to scheduled posts, with error handling for marshaling.
